interpretation: The frozen S08 pool fed to S09 contained 12 off-topic cards (no proton-conductor descriptor claim), several with very high REAL citations (up to 1391). The real LLM agent adopted 0 of them into any family/instance/registry. So the published pipeline did NOT chase citation hype — but note this is the COMBINED effect of (a) the evidence-constrained architecture (off-topic cards carry no descriptor claim, so they are hard to select by construction) AND (b) the LLM. It is NOT proof of standalone LLM judgement, because the off-topic cards were structurally evidence-empty.
honest_limit: To prove standalone LLM resistance you would have to feed the LLM off-topic cards that ALSO carry (fabricated) proton-conductor descriptor claims and see if it rejects them. That requires fabricating literature evidence, which violates the project's honesty guardrails, so it must NOT be done.
